verses.text: A psalm. A song for the dedication of the temple. Of David. I will praise you highly, LORD, because you lifted me up. You did not let my enemies celebrate over me.
LORD my God, I cried to you for help, and you healed me.
LORD, you brought me up from the grave. You kept me alive so I did not go down into the pit.
Sing praise to the LORD, all you his faithful people. Thank him and remember his holy name.
His anger lasts only a moment, but his kindness lasts a lifetime. Crying may last through the night, but joy comes in the morning.
When things were going well for me, I said, "Nothing will ever shake me."
LORD, when you were kind to me, you made me as strong as a mountain. But when you hid your face, I was terrified.
I cried to you, LORD. I begged the Lord for mercy:
"What good will it do if I die, if I go down into the pit? Can dust praise you? Can it tell how faithful you are?
Hear me, LORD, and be kind to me. LORD, be my helper."
You turned my crying into dancing. You took off my clothes of sadness and dressed me with joy,
so that my heart may sing praises to you and not be silent. LORD my God, I will thank you forever!
